value: one of four Portuguese chicken breeds, alongside the Amarela, Branca and Pedres Portuguesa
listed in the Slow Food Foundation's Ark of Taste

history_summary.value: The Preta Lusitanica is a traditional black breed from north-western Portugal that declined sharply in the mid-1900s as imported industrial chicken strains took over farming. Conservation efforts brought it back from under 2,000 breeding hens in the early 2000s to a healthy population by 2024, no longer considered at risk.
